Mitsuki, her daughter, helped her mother in times when she felt heartbroken, and began to take care of Tsukiya, her brother-in-law, more than before, and Tsukiya adored having such a kind older sister.

In addition, his aunt, Aoyama Reika, who is in the middle of a quarrel with her husband and returning home, and her daughter, Aoyama Rio, greet him.

A pervert who loves bondage, Kyoichi Mitsugi’s life is a story of a young man who has a perverted nature, whose life took a sudden turn after his father’s sudden remarriage.

His mother and sisters, with their haughty attitude and self-importance, had been living a carefree life until one summer day, when Kyouichi’s frustration and desire peaked. He pushed down Mizuno, his mother, in a fit of lust, and was kicked out of the house.

item.title: Kuraibito
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: TinkerBell
  • 発売日: 2012-01-20
  • スコア: 6.709999999999999/10 (32 人評価)

别名

  • くらいびと

あらすじ

Kotone Takashina, Mami Yuzuki and Yuuri Kanou are three high-school students members of the Mystery Club of their school looking for spooky events happening around. One day, after she discovered via Internet about a ruined place located in a forest near of their town, Kotone decide to check it with her friends. However, a sudden downpour take the three girls by surprise and instead of ruins, they discovered an European-styled mansion who belongs to a mysterious man and his young twin sisters. The man, Shuuya Houjou, allows them to stay inside of his house until the downpour ends, but the three girls will soon learn about the dreadful secret hidden inside of the mansion…

item.title: Ryou Seibai! ~Gakuen Bishoujo Seisai Hiroku~
item.description:

  • 発売日: 2011-10-21

  • 英語名: Ryou Seibai! Gakuen Bishoujo Seisai Hiroku

あらすじ

Private Kibitsu Academy is a prestigious high school that attracts talented students from different backgrounds. Despite most of its students are beautiful females, the school has many problems, one of which is the Gakuseikai, an autonomous group that controls the academy. The protagonist, Hinase Kyouichirou, lives a happy life with his sister-in-law and teacher Saki, until she is assaulted by members of the Gakuseikai and falls into a state of mental breakdown. A school nurse Yamiko Shiroyuki approaches Kyouichirou and invites him to become a member of her team of auditors to defeat the Gakuseikai. Frustrated with his own powerlessness, he agrees to join the team and swear to bring justice to the school.

Initially disappointed that he can’t kick back and relax and game all summer, he finds his fortunes turned around when he discovers that the job is at a timeshare owned by his friend’s glamorous widowed mother. He ends up at the summer house surrounded by a pair of incredibly beautiful and well endowed mothers and daughters, making for all sorts of lovely summer memories.
